ps.en: When a young [[genius]] developed the [[habit]] of visiting a remote wetland, she tried to [[generalize]] a rule for protecting the [[habitat]] of rare birds. Yet a physical [[handicap]] began to [[hamper]] her daily work in the field.
ps.zh: 一位年轻的天才养成了探访偏远湿地的习惯，她试图从中归纳出拯救所有栖息地的法则。然而，身体上的缺陷开始妨碍她在野外的日常工作。

ps.en: To keep the project alive, she learned to [[shield]] her team from doubt and [[shift]] their attention from problems to solutions. She [[shouldered|shoulder]] the heaviest tasks herself, and soon began to [[show]] what quiet determination could build.
ps.zh: 为了让项目延续，她学会保护团队免受质疑，并把注意力从问题转移到办法上。她独自扛起最重的任务，很快开始展现坚定意志能建起什么。

ps.en: After a long [[shower]] of public attention and the [[glamour]] of awards, her device could [[generate]] clean power for a whole [[generation]] of villagers. The small [[generator]] she built proved that a [[generous]] mind and a true genius need no perfect body.
ps.zh: 在公众关注与奖项光环一阵涌来之后，她的装置能为整代村民产生清洁能源。她造出的小发电机证明，慷慨的心灵与真正的天才从不需要完美的躯体。

ps.en: A celebrated director of the [[genre]] known for its [[gigantic]] dreams had once been a [[giant]] of the old cinema. Then his career ended and his money went with it. One winter a stranger offered to [[give]] him a second chance at life, and it arrived as an unexpected [[gift]].
ps.zh: 一位以宏大梦境闻名的类型片名导，曾是旧影业的巨头。后来他的事业终止，钱也随之散尽。某个冬天，一位陌生人愿意让他重活一次——这份机会，成了一份意外的礼物。

ps.en: His early years had been [[harsh]], and many things had [[happened|happen]] to [[harm]] the people he loved. [[Ignorant|ignorant]] of his own limits, he let [[ignorance]] grow, and chose to [[ignore]] the warnings of those who cared.
ps.zh: 他早年的岁月十分严酷，许多事的发生伤害了他所爱的人。由于对自己的极限一无所知，他任由无知滋长，并选择忽视关爱者的警告。

ps.en: When he grew [[ill]] with a slow [[illness]], he finally understood that true [[harmony]] comes not from fame but from truth. The [[illusion]] of greatness faded, and what remained was the simple gift of another day.
ps.zh: 当他因慢性疾病卧床时，才终于明白真正的和谐不来自名望而来自真实。伟大的错觉褪去，留下的只是多活一天的朴素馈赠。

ps.en: To [[illustrate]] a difficult idea, the professor drew an [[illustration]] that changed how students saw the world. It forced them to [[imagine]] a society built not on force but on reason.
ps.zh: 为了阐明一个艰深观点，教授画了一幅插图，改变了学生看世界的方式。它迫使他们想象一个不以强力、而以理性建构的社会。

ps.en: Some preferred the safe [[image]] of the past, while others built [[imaginary]] cities with pure [[imagination]]. The most [[imaginative]] among them learned to [[imitate]] no one, refusing every hollow [[imitation]] of thought.
ps.zh: 有人偏爱过去那安全的形象，有人则用纯粹的想象力建造虚构之城。其中最有想象力的人学会不模仿任何人，拒绝一切空洞的思想仿制。

ps.en: A wise teacher can [[lead]] without claiming [[leadership]], and the [[leading]] voice in a room is not always the loudest. Within [[legal]] bounds, sound [[legislation]] makes power [[legitimate]]; in our [[leisure]], we choose what to believe.
ps.zh: 明智的老师能够领导而不自称领袖，而房间里引领众声的未必嗓门最大。在法律的边界内，健全的立法使权力正当；于闲暇中，我们选择相信什么。

ps.en: The new government received a clear [[mandate]] to reform, yet its first duty was to [[manage]] a country on the edge of collapse. Poor [[management]] would let chaos [[manifest]] in the streets.
ps.zh: 新政府获得明确的改革授权，但首要职责是管理一个濒临崩溃的国家。糟糕的管理会让混乱在街头显现。

ps.en: Officials learned to [[manipulate]] public opinion, while the gap between rich and poor widened to a dangerous [[level]]. They used every [[lever]] of power to [[levy]] a tax that hurt the weak, and did so in a polite [[manner]].
ps.zh: 官员学会操纵舆论，贫富差距扩大到危险的水平。他们动用每一根权力的杠杆，征收一种伤害弱者的税，且做得彬彬有礼。

ps.en: On the [[margin]] of society, the [[marginal]] became a [[mass]] movement; a [[massive]] protest forced the army to end its [[occupation]] and [[occupy]] only what law allowed. The memory of the old [[massacre]] warned them not to repeat it.
ps.zh: 在社会边缘，边缘者汇成一场群众运动；一场大规模抗议迫使军队结束占领，只占据法律允许之物。旧日大屠杀的记忆警示他们勿重蹈覆辙。

ps.en: During a training course, a strange [[occurrence]] began to [[occur]] each morning: a senior colleague would [[offend]] no one yet still [[offer]] help. His calm seemed to [[offset]] the stress of the young.
ps.zh: 在一次培训中，怪事每晨发生：一位资深同事从不冒犯谁，却总伸出援手。他的沉着似乎抵消了年轻人的压力。

ps.en: He spoke of his late wife and their [[offspring]], then pointed to a single [[paragraph]] in the manual. A wrong word can [[paralyse]] a whole team, he said, drawing a [[parallel]] between care and results.
ps.zh: 他谈起亡妻与后代，随后指向手册中的一段。他说，一句错话足以让整个团队瘫痪，并在关怀与成果之间画下类比。

ps.en: As a fair [[partner]], he took no [[part]] that was [[partial]], and every [[participant]] was free to [[participate]]. He noticed one [[particle]] of doubt in a [[particular]] face, and smiled — the silence was [[partly]] his own fault.
ps.zh: 身为公正的伙伴，他不参与任何偏袒的一方，每位参与者都可自由参加。他注意到某张特定面孔上一丝疑虑，微微一笑——这份沉默部分归咎于他自己。

ps.en: A young [[scientist]] began a [[quest]] to understand climate, driven by a deep [[passion]] for the planet. She would not stay [[passive]] while the data demanded action.
ps.zh: 一位年轻科学家开启理解气候的探索，源于对星球的深切热情。当数据发出行动的信号，她不愿袖手旁观。

ps.en: Her [[quick]] mind refused to [[quit]], even when a long [[questionnaire]] seemed to lead nowhere. She would [[quote]] the old masters and let the work [[span]] a decade of patient study.
ps.zh: 她敏捷的头脑拒绝放弃，即便一份冗长的问卷似乎毫无头绪。她会引用先贤，让研究跨越十年的耐心。

ps.en: With no time to [[spare]], she kept a strict [[schedule]] and a bold [[scheme]] to share [[science]] in a [[scientific]] way. In the end, her quest gave the public a clearer picture of the world.
ps.zh: 分秒必争，她严守日程，并定下大胆方案以科学的方式分享科学。最终，她的探索让公众更清晰地看见世界。

c: generalize from... 从…归纳
generalize a rule 概括出一条法则
words.dif: generalize 指从具体到普遍（归纳）；specify 是「具体说明」，方向相反
words.pat: We can generalize from these cases to a broader rule.
words.patZh: 我们可以从这些案例归纳出更广泛的法则。

c: form a habit 养成习惯
a good habit 好习惯
out of habit 出于习惯
words.dif: habit 指个人长期养成的习惯；custom 偏社会或群体的习俗
words.pat: He formed the habit of reading before sleep.
words.patZh: 他养成了睡前阅读的习惯。

c: natural habitat 自然栖息地
destroy a habitat 破坏栖息地
fam: habitat 常作单数 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: habitat 强调物种自然生存的环境；environment 泛指周遭环境
words.pat: The forest is the natural habitat of many birds.
words.patZh: 这片森林是许多鸟类的自然栖息地。

c: hamper one's progress 妨碍进步
hamper the rescue 阻碍救援
fam: hamper n. 洗衣篮（同形异义）
words.dif: hamper 侧重「捆绑式拖累」；hinder 最常用且中性；block 是正面堵死
words.pat: Snow may hamper the delivery of supplies.
words.patZh: 大雪可能阻碍物资运送。

c: a physical handicap 身体缺陷
under a handicap 处于不利地位
words.dif: handicap 既可指身体障碍也可指不利条件；drawback 是缺点
words.pat: His handicap did not stop him from winning.
words.patZh: 他的缺陷并未阻止他获胜。

c: shield sb from harm 保护…免受伤害
a shield against... 抵御…的护盾
words.dif: shield 强调挡开外来伤害；shelter 强调提供避难所
words.pat: The wall shielded them from the wind.
words.patZh: 那堵墙帮他们挡住了风。

c: shift one's attention 转移注意力
shift to... 转向…
night shift 夜班
words.dif: shift 侧重位置或重点的移动；alter 侧重本质性改动
words.pat: We must shift our focus to quality.
words.patZh: 我们必须把重心转移到质量上。

c: shoulder the burden 肩负重担
shoulder responsibility 承担责任
words.dif: shoulder 作动词表主动承担；bear 语气更重且常被动承受
words.pat: She shouldered the burden without complaint.
words.patZh: 她毫无怨言地肩负起重担。

words.exam: 显示；表明；证明；展览；演出
c: show that... 表明…
on show 在展出
a talent show 才艺演出
words.dif: show 最通用；demonstrate 强调论证式展示；exhibit 偏公开展览
words.pat: The data show a clear upward trend.
words.patZh: 数据显示出明显的上升趋势。

words.exam: 阵雨；淋浴；使纷纷降落；大量地给
c: a shower of praise 一阵赞扬
take a shower 淋浴
shower sb with gifts 纷纷给…送礼
words.dif: shower 本义阵雨，引申为大量骤降的物或情感；downpour 仅指大雨
words.pat: A shower of questions followed the speech.
words.patZh: 演讲后紧接着是一阵提问。

c: the glamour of the city 都市的魅力
add glamour to... 为…增添魅力
words.dif: glamour 偏耀眼、奢华的吸引力；charm 偏温和的魅力
words.pat: The glamour of fame faded with time.
words.patZh: 名望的魅力随岁月消退。

c: generate electricity 发电
generate interest 引起兴趣
generate profit 产生利润
words.dif: generate 强调使能量或结果发生；produce 最通用
words.pat: Wind turbines generate clean electricity.
words.patZh: 风力涡轮机产生清洁电力。

c: the younger generation 年轻一代
generation gap 代沟
the next generation 下一代
words.dif: generation 表一代人或代，也表产生；generation of heat 搭配「产生」义
words.pat: The next generation will decide our climate future.
words.patZh: 下一代将决定我们气候的未来。

c: a portable generator 便携发电机
a steam generator 蒸汽发生器
words.dif: generator 指产生能量或信号的装置；engine 是引擎
words.pat: The generator failed during the blackout.
words.patZh: 停电时发电机出了故障。

c: be generous with... 在…上慷慨
a generous gift 厚礼
generous support 大力支持
words.dif: generous 既可指人慷慨也可指数量丰沛；stingy 是其反义
words.pat: She is generous with her time and advice.
words.patZh: 她在时间与建议上都很慷慨。

c: a musical genius 音乐天才
have a genius for... 有…的天赋
fam: geniuses 复数 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: genius 指极高的天赋或天才人物；talent 是一般才能
words.pat: His genius surprised everyone who met him.
words.patZh: 他的天赋令每个见到他的人惊讶。

c: a birthday gift 生日礼物
have a gift for... 有…的天赋
a gift of speech 口才
words.dif: gift 兼礼物与天赋；present 仅指礼物
words.pat: Talent is a precious gift that needs practice.
words.patZh: 天赋是需以练习打磨的珍贵礼物。

c: a literary genre 文学体裁
a new genre of music 新型音乐
fam: genres 复数 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: genre 专指文艺作品的体裁或类型；type 泛指类型
words.pat: This genre appeals to young readers.
words.patZh: 这种体裁吸引年轻读者。

c: a tech giant 科技巨头
a giant corporation 巨型公司
words.dif: giant 作名词指巨头，作形容词指巨大的；gigantic 只作形容词
words.pat: The company grew into a global giant.
words.patZh: 这家公司成长为全球巨头。

c: a gigantic wave 巨浪
a gigantic task 庞大任务
words.dif: gigantic 强调大得惊人；large 只是大，程度轻
words.pat: A gigantic wave rose from the sea.
words.patZh: 一道巨浪从海中升起。

c: give sb a chance 给…机会
give up 放弃
give way 让步
fam: give-gave-given 不规则变化 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: give 表给予或提供，最核心义；take 是其反义
words.pat: They give him a second chance to try.
words.patZh: 他们给了他再试一次的机会。

c: happen to do 碰巧做
whatever happens 无论发生什么
happen upon 偶然发现
fam: happened / happening n. 相关延伸
words.dif: happen 最口语化、指偶然或自动发生；occur 更正式；take place 指按计划发生
words.pat: What will happen if we do nothing?
words.patZh: 如果我们什么都不做，会发生什么？

c: do harm to 对…有害
harm the environment 危害环境
come to harm 受到伤害
words.dif: harm 泛指伤害或损害；hurt 多指情感或身体痛；damage 多指物损
words.pat: Pollution can harm wildlife and people.
words.patZh: 污染会危害野生动物和人类。

c: social harmony 社会和谐
in harmony with... 与…协调
live in harmony 和睦相处
words.dif: harmony 强调多元素协调统一；peace 仅指无冲突
words.pat: Social harmony requires mutual trust.
words.patZh: 社会和谐需要相互信任。

c: harsh weather 严酷天气
a harsh punishment 严厉惩罚
a harsh voice 刺耳的声音
words.dif: harsh 强调刺耳、刺目或苛刻；strict 指要求严格但未必无情
words.pat: The harsh winter tested their resolve.
words.patZh: 严酷的冬天考验了他们的决心。

c: out of ignorance 出于无知
blissful ignorance 无知的天真
ignore one's ignorance 无视自己的无知
words.dif: ignorance 是名词「无知的状态」；ignorant 是形容词「无知的」
words.pat: Ignorance is no excuse for breaking the law.
words.patZh: 无知不能成为违法的借口。

words.exam: 无知的；愚昧的；不知道的
c: be ignorant of... 对…一无所知
an ignorant mistake 出于无知的错误
words.dif: ignorant 形容人无知或不了解；naive 强调天真缺乏经验
words.pat: He was ignorant of the risk ahead.
words.patZh: 他对前方的危险一无所知。

c: ignore the warning 忽视警告
ignore sb 不理睬某人
words.dif: ignore 是故意不理或无视；neglect 是疏忽忘做；overlook 是漏看
words.pat: Do not ignore early signs of trouble.
words.patZh: 不要忽视问题的早期征兆。

c: fall ill 生病
ill effects 坏影响
speak ill of... 说…坏话
words.dif: ill 作形容词多作表语（fall ill）；sick 可作定语（a sick child）
words.pat: He fell ill and missed the meeting.
words.patZh: 他病倒了，错过了会议。

c: a serious illness 重病
recover from illness 病愈
fam: illnesses 复数 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: illness 泛指生病状态；disease 指具体病症或疾患
words.pat: Her illness kept her at home for weeks.
words.patZh: 她的病让她在家休养了数周。

c: an optical illusion 视觉错觉
create an illusion 制造错觉
under an illusion 误以为
words.dif: illusion 指感官或认知上的错觉；delusion 多指病态妄想
words.pat: The illusion of safety can be dangerous.
words.patZh: 安全的错觉可能很危险。

c: illustrate a point 阐明观点
illustrate with examples 用例子说明
illustrate a book 给书配图
words.dif: illustrate 侧重用图或实例说明；explain 是一般性解释
words.pat: Let me illustrate this with a simple example.
words.patZh: 让我用一个简单例子来阐明这一点。

c: by way of illustration 举例说明
a vivid illustration 生动的插图
an illustration of... …的例证
words.dif: illustration 可指插图也可指例证；example 仅指例子
words.pat: The chart serves as a clear illustration.
words.patZh: 这张图表是一个清晰的例证。

c: brand image 品牌形象
improve one's image 改善形象
the image of... …的形象
words.dif: image 强调公众或心中形象；picture 偏具体画面
words.pat: The scandal damaged the company's image.
words.patZh: 丑闻损害了公司的形象。

c: imagine doing 想象做
imagine that... 设想…
hard to imagine 难以想象
words.dif: imagine 最常用在脑中构想；envisage 偏预见或规划性地设想
words.pat: Imagine a world without poverty.
words.patZh: 想象一个没有贫困的世界。

c: an imaginary friend 虚构的朋友
an imaginary number 虚数
words.dif: imaginary 指想象出来的、非真实存在的；imaginative 指人富有想象力的
words.pat: The child's friend was entirely imaginary.
words.patZh: 那孩子的朋友完全是虚构的。

c: lack imagination 缺乏想象力
use one's imagination 发挥想象
capture the imagination 激发想象
fam: imaginative adj. 富有想象力的
words.dif: imagination 是想象力或空想；imaginary 是虚构的事物
words.pat: Imagination drives every great invention.
words.patZh: 想象力推动每一项伟大发明。

c: an imaginative writer 富有想象力的作家
an imaginative solution 巧妙的解法
words.dif: imaginative 形容人或作品有创造力；imaginary 形容事物是虚构的
words.pat: Children are naturally imaginative.
words.patZh: 孩子天生富有想象力。

c: imitate one's style 模仿某人的风格
imitate a bird's call 模仿鸟叫
words.dif: imitate 中性模仿；mimic 常带滑稽或刻意学样；emulate 含赶超意
words.pat: Children imitate the behavior of adults.
words.patZh: 孩子会模仿大人的行为。

c: in imitation of... 模仿…
an imitation of leather 仿皮
a poor imitation 拙劣的仿制品
words.dif: imitation 可作模仿行为或仿制品；original 是其反义
words.pat: Imitation is the sincerest form of flattery.
words.patZh: 模仿是最真诚的恭维。

words.exam: 领导；引导；领先；通向；导致
c: lead a team 领导团队
lead to... 导致…
lead the way 引路
words.dif: lead 最通用引导或领先；guide 强调指路；cause 专指导致
words.pat: She will lead the project to success.
words.patZh: 她将领导这个项目走向成功。

c: under his leadership 在他的领导下
a change in leadership 领导层更迭
words.dif: leadership 指领导能力或领导层；leader 指领导者个人
words.pat: His leadership inspired the whole team.
words.patZh: 他的领导力鼓舞了整个团队。

words.exam: 领导的；顶尖的；位居前列的；最主要的
c: a leading expert 顶尖专家
play a leading role 起主导作用
the leading cause 主要原因
words.dif: leading 指位居前列或主导的；main 仅表主要的
words.pat: He is a leading voice in the field.
words.patZh: 他是该领域最具代表性的声音。

c: legal advice 法律咨询
legal right 合法权利
take legal action 采取法律行动
words.dif: legal 指符合法律的；lawful 强调法律所允许的；legitimate 常指合理正当的
words.pat: You have a legal right to remain silent.
words.patZh: 你拥有保持沉默的合法权利。

words.exam: 立法；法律的制定（或通过）
c: pass legislation 通过立法
new legislation on... 关于…的新法
environmental legislation 环境立法
words.dif: legislation 是法律或立法（集合）；law 可指单条法律或学科
words.pat: New legislation protects consumer rights.
words.patZh: 新立法保护消费者权益。

c: a legitimate government 合法政府
a legitimate concern 合理的担忧
legitimate business 正当生意
words.dif: legitimate 兼合法的和合理的或正当的；legal 仅指法律上的
words.pat: A legitimate government serves its people.
words.patZh: 合法的政府服务于人民。

c: in one's leisure 在闲暇时
leisure time 闲暇时光
at leisure 从容地
